title: HP Introduces First HyperX Open-Back Headset, Lightweight Carbon Fiber Mouse and More - CNET
summary: HP will be releasing three new HyperX Pulsefire Haste 3 mice, targeting different subsets of casual, hobbyist and hard-core gamers (with a price to match). The Pulsefire Haste 3 wired mouse is the entry-level product in the new mouse lineup.
